name: KOverlay
summary: Popover, drawer, sheet and menu: role=dialog, the app behind inert, Tab kept inside, Escape / Close / scrim close it, focus returns to the trigger. Bordered, never a shadow.

kind.description: A popover and a menu become a bottom sheet on a phone; sheets are a phone pattern.

trigger.description: A structured value: see the component's TypeScript type.

onClose.description: Runs however it closes: a removed approval settles as cancelled.

notes: One floating thing at a time, except an approval asked from inside one, which stacks over it.

dont: Never a toast or an unlabelled close.
